the mechanisms that regulate the expression of chondrogenic genes in chondrocytic cells in vitro and in vivo, and with the use of this knowledge to improve the quality of cartilage repair.
the regulation of the type-II collagen gene and the role of SOX transcription factor in the control of chondrogenesis and chondrogenic differentiation in vitro.
the mechanisms involved in chondrocytic de-differentiation, and the re-differentiation that is induced when cells are cultured in three-dimensional systems.

the phenotype of chondroctytes is regulated in part by SOX transcription factors and that these factors are modulated by the extracellular matrix.

the phenotype of chondroctyes is modulated in vitro by culture conditions, which in turn are mediated through the activity of the SOX transcription factor family.

the phenotype recovery process can be modulated by the use of appropriate three-dimensional culture systems and that the SOX transcription factors are involved in the control process.
